name: io.github.granitebps/youtube-mcp
title: YouTube MCP
description: Independent, unofficial project for YouTube metadata, transcripts, comments, and search.

environmentVariables.name: YT_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Video info/comments/search: "innertube" (default, unofficial, no key) or "api" (official YouTube Data API v3). Transcripts always use unofficial youtube-transcript-plus.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own YouTube Data API v3 key (BYOK). Required when YT_PROVIDER is "api"; not used for transcripts.
